scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: AK Markram
batting.dismissal: c T Stubbs b PVD Chameera

batting.name: Abishek Porel
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b AK Markram

balls.text: bowled him too! Mukesh goes full and straight from around the wicket, Pant tries to play the reverse lap past short third, the ball hits his pads and then hits the stumps. LSG's 159 is their lowest score this season.
charges down the pitch at a short of a length ball and slogs across the line, misses it
bowled him! He aims for a fourth boundary by walking across his stumps to swat the ball past short fine, Mukesh keeps it full and straight and misses
three in a row, this time behind point, Mukesh keeps giving Badoni width and this time he stays back and slashes behind point
another loose ball, a full toss wide outside off and Badoni dispatches it again to the cover boundary with a powerful drive
width outside off and Badoni frees his arms to loft the ball over the in field and into the gap on the cover boundary
backs away outside leg to a short of a length ball and cuts it through point
over the wicket this time and nearly in the blockhole again, dug out on the leg side for a single
Starc aims for the boot with the yorker from around the wicket and hits it after Miller misses the flick
shorter slower one, Badoni backs away towards leg to cut to deep third once again but mis-times it wide of the keeper

a full toss homing in on the exposed stumps as Badoni gets into position for the reverse swat by backing away outside leg, makes great contact and sends the ball flying between the keeper and short third
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Miller stays back and hits it to long on for a single
moves wide outside off to try and drag the ball towards leg but misses and gets hit on the body, another slower wide one from Chameera
he's timed this all right! Stubbs races to his right on the deep cover boundary and dives but can't stop it. Badoni used the width outside off to flay a slower one with a full swing of his arms
a full toss on the pads but Badoni gets neither power nor distance on that flick-whip, the fielder at deep square runs to his right to make the save
moves outside off to a wide one and cuts to deep point
good length on leg stump, Miller goes back and works the ball off his pads through square leg, was a slower delivery
full ball angling across Miller, nearly in the blockhole, dug out to cover
Miller mis-times the shot off the back foot through cover, dragging it towards long off instead, Kuldeep kept it wide outside off and spun it away
wide ball outside off, Badoni cuts to deep point
tossed up on leg and it turns a bit across the left-hander, nudged off the front foot through midwicket
that's a bit too wide outside off, Miller lets it go
gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball to deep backward square leg
worked off the pads in front of square leg for a single
wide outside off with turn away from Miller who goes back and cuts in front of point
short of a length and the bounce gets big on Badoni just outside off, the movement into him cramps him for room as he tries to cut and gets beaten
short of a length delivery skirting the wide line outside off, Badoni lets it go and hopes for the wide, doesn't get it
a full ball swinging on to the pads and Badoni moves across to play a wristy flick into the gap between long leg and deep backward square
nudged off the front foot through point for a single

dropped by Stubbs running in from deep point! There was width outside off stump and some movement away from the right-hander, Badoni chased it and slashed, hitting the ball flat over the in-field, Stubbs covered lots of ground to get to the ball but grassed it as he slid forward
he's getting the ball to move into the right-hander from outside off, defended on the front foot to the bowler
goes back and across and hits the ball to wide long on
nudged off the back foot in front of square, he's hit it gently so there's time to sprint the second before the fielder in the deep gets his throw in
tossed up on middle and off, Badoni defends on the front foot
goes back and pulls the ball to deep midwicket
defended watchfully on the front foot
what power from Miller, drags the ball with the slog sweep from outside off, along the ground and to the left of the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary

bowls him with a superb yorker! Marsh looks shocked at what's happened. Late dip and movement into the right-hander, sneaking under the descending bat as Marsh tries to jam down on it, he misses and the ball hits the base of off stump
cut off the back foot to deep third for a single
full ball searching for the blockhole, driven to wide long on for a single
short of a length from around the wicket, cut hard off the back foot to deep point
caught and bowled! Short of a length again and it seemed to stick in the pitch a bit, 136 kph so not a slower ball. Samad was a touch early on the pull shot and hit it tamely back to the bowler
short of a length and straight from over the wicket, Samand defends back to the bowler
Starc does well on the wide long off boundary to save the four. Marsh had given that a powerful smack off the back foot, freeing those huge arms with the width on offer outside off
worked off the pads through square leg, Samad is struggling for fluency
played through the covers for a single
drags the slog sweep from wide outside off towards cow corner, Stubbs covers a lot of ground and slides to make the save
steps out and drives the ball to long on
gets down on one knee and sweeps to deep backward square leg
fuller ball outside off, dug out to backward point
pace off again, length ball outside off, Samad tries to pull and misses
full ball angling across the right-hander from over the wicket, Samad wafts at it and is beaten on the front foot
good length on off stump, Samad tries to play on the leg side but gets an inside edge on to the pad

he's got him again! For the fifth time in all T20s in just 14 balls. Slower short ball angling into the left-hander from over the wicket, Pooran tries to pull and drags it back on to his stumps via the bottom edge
full toss slanting across the right-hander from over the wicket, driven to deep point
tossed up wider outside off, Pooran goes back and tries to cut as it spins away from him and misses
goes back and nudges the ball off his pads through square leg
three sweeps in a row but this time to the fielder at deep midwicket
two in a row, places the sweep fine this time, wide of the fielder at short fine leg, moves forward and across and sweeps from his stumps
shot! Plants his front foot forward and across and absolutely nails the sweep, all along the ground and into the gap on the deep square boundary
Marsh goes back and across to pull the ball and gets a bit of a top edge towards deep backward square leg
that's the end of Makram, he backs away towards leg and tries to launch a full ball over the cover boundary, that's the bigger boundary tonight, 72 metres, and Stubbs takes the catch in the deep
drilled hard down the ground but the fielder at long off runs to his right and prevents the boundary
in the blockhole on middl stump, dug out to long on for one more, fourth consecutive single so Chameera is doing well this over
a slower ball on off and middle, driven to long off for one more

a fuller ball and that's a shoddy effort at cover, allows the single. Vipraj the fielder. And on watching the replays he did get a little bit of bad bounce. Markram had dug out a full ball firmly to cover
a length ball outside off, Marsh waits in his crease and plays a powerful square drive to the fielder at deep point
slower short ball, Markram waits and swivel-pulls it to deep midwicket to bring up 50 off 30 balls, he's having a terrific season as an opener for LSG
fuller ball around off stump, Marsh drives to long off on the front foot
short ball from over the wicket aimed at Markram's head, he stays so steady as he pulls along the ground to deep square
short of a length with width outside off from over the wicket across the right-hander, Marsh goes back and slaps the ball hard through cover point
slower ball at 124.5 kph on a wicket to wicket line, Markram nudges between midwicket and long on for a single
pulled against the angle from over the wicket through midwicket, that wasn't that short at all and Marsh was cramped for room
driven off the back foot through point for a single
goes back to one on the stumps and punches through cover point
cut off the back foot through point
dragged short again and Marsh gets down on one knee and pulls behind square for another boundary

he's hit that high in the air, it's a mis-hit, but it's falling on the edge of the 30-yard circle at mid on and there's no one there, Starc comes sprinting in from the long-on boundary and dives but can't get there in tiem to take the catch. Markram tried to pull that again but the pace was slower and he didn't time it well
starts with a long hop and Markram goes back, clears his front leg towards the leg side, and pulls the ball into the stands at deep midwicket
Markram wants the single but Marsh sends him back after pushing straight to point, but a fumble allows the single in the end
nudged off the pads through midwicket for one more
driven off the front foot to long off for a single
similar placement down the ground towards long on but with no where near the same power as the previous shot, Starc fumbles in the deep
goes back and absolutely thumps the good length ball with a flat bat between the bowler and the non-striker, hit with tremendous power
goes back and across his stumps to play the ball with the angle into him in front of square leg
full ball slanting into Marsh who drives to long on for a single
slower one on off and middle, Markram stays in his crease and drives to long off
Missed everything, the bat and the stumps. Markram had a huge swipe across the line at a short of a length ball and didn't make contact, that was pretty skiddy from Chameera with the cross seam
slower ball bowled full and on the pads, Markram leans across and flicks behind square
driven hard into the covers where the fielder dives to take pace off the shot

whoops, tough welcome. Length ball angling into the right-hander, Marsh stands in his crease and lofts it over deep backward square leg with a pick up shot, hitting it deep into the stands on the shorter side of the ground
pushed down the ground to long off for a single
moves back and towards leg and drives into the covers
swung with the angle into him from around the wicket through square leg
pushed off the front foot to long off for a single
second boundary off Axar today, that's short and wide and Marsh drives hard off the back foot, in the air past the diving Porel at cover
nudged off the front foot on the leg side
fullish length angling into Markram from over the wicket, meets it on the front foot but can't beat the fielder at cover with the drive
low full toss on a wicket to wicket line, Marsh drives to long on for a single
punched from the crease to long off for a single

launched miles over the straight boundary! Gentle pace, on a length, Markram presses forward and lofts through the line with the high elbow, that's a 78 metre boundary down the ground and he cleared it easily
this time he gets an edge that goes along the ground straight to short third, was looking to punch that through the off side
short of a length outside off, Markram slashes and beats the fielder at short third to his right
loud call of NO after Marsh pushes the ball off the pads to midwicket, Markram wanted a quick single
driven firmly but along the ground and to the fielder at cover
punched off the back foot to long off for one more
driven to mid on for a single

Vipraj misfields on the wide long off boundary and allows the four! Marsh had driven a fuller ball with outstanding timing but the fielder should have stopped that after getting to it by running to his left on the boundary
angles into the right-hander from around the wicket, punched off the back foot to long off
short of a length around middle and off, Marsh plays it off the back foot to point
fuller ball outside off, dug out to deep point for a single
first boundary of the game and it comes off a short ball, Markram met it on the front foot and pulled it high and far over square leg, that's the short boundary too, 60 metres
a fuller ball this time, Starc is looking for that swing back into the right-hander after slanting across him from over the wicket, Markram drives on the front foot to mid-off
straighter line on a good length, Markram stays in his crease and defends as the ball shapes back into him from over the wicket
angles across the right-hander from over the wicket, slashed off the front foot to deep point
nearly played on! Marsh tries to punch the ball off the back foot on the off side but gets a thick inside edge past the stumps, that skidded into him quickly
bowled slower through the air on a wicket to wicket line, pushed back to the bowler
driven along the ground to wide long off, played that from deep in his crease
moves back and across to work the ball with the angle into him from around the wicket through midwicket
goes back and punches to long off for a single
played off the back foot into the covers

KL Rahul seals the thumping victory against LSG with a six! Short ball and he pulls it flat over the deep midwicket boundary. No emotional celebrations from him tonight, unlike the RCB game in Bengaluru, two points in the bag, DC are up to 12 along with GT at the top of the table. Job done.
a full toss with some swing away from the left-hander, driven down the ground, the fielder at long on runs to his right to pick it up
full and straight, driven to long on for a single from the blockhole to bring up 5000 runs in the IPL
backs away and pulls the short of a length ball to deep midwicket

stays in his crease and flicks the ball off the pads towards midwicket to bring up his third half-century of the season, it's going to be a match-winning one against his former team, guided this chase superbly has KL Rahul
fired it flat and fast outside off, past the edge of Axar's slashing bat
Axar plants his front foot down the pitch and mows across the line, hitting it clean out of the middle and far over deep midwicket
cut off the back foot through point
Prince has dropped a sitter at short third. Awful. Axar was aiming for the booming loft down the ground off the front foot and got a top edge that looped up so gently to short third and he spilled it
cut off the back foot to deep point
goes back and across and taps the ball off his pads in front of square leg
in the blockhole again on off and middle, Rahul makes room and drives to mid off
in the blockhole around off stump, Axar drives to the fielder at cover
the slower bouncer and it flies over the reach of Axar's attempted ramp
Axar transfers his weight on to his back foot, stays in his crease, and just heaves the short of a length ball far over the wide long-on boundary
full and straight, driven down the ground to long on
the slower short ball over Rahul's left shoulder, he pulls and gets a top edge wide of the diving Pant for a boundary to fine leg
similar ball, another slower bouncer that Axar gets under and tries to upper cut, he can't connect again and looks at the umpire for the wide, this time it's a legal delivery
too short and Axar can't connect with the ramp, the slower bouncer that was and it was far too high over the head
just clears the leaping fielder at mid-off! Axar backed away outside leg to a length ball aimed at his stumps and drove it flat and just high enough to go over the fielder in the circle
short of a length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Axar misses the pull shot
moves forward and plays the square drive through point to a fuller ball
in the blockhole on middle stump, Rahul digs it out back to the bowler
short of a length outside off, slower one, Rahul tries to cut but is beaten by the change of pace
high and far over the straight boundary this time, Bishnoi gave that some air from around the wicket, Axar met it on the front foot and freed those long arms once again
played off the back foot to cover
Axar frees his arms and lofts the ball clean over the deep midwicket boundary, that wasn't particularly full but he used his long reach and made great contact
tries to drive through the off side but gets an airy edge through point for a single
backs away towards leg and exposes his stumps before swatting the googly into the covers
pushed into the covers from deep in his crease
low full toss flicked off the pads through square leg for a single
short of a length with some width outside off, cut off the back foot to deep point
another short ball which Axar tries to pull but misses

digs in the bouncer and Axar lets it go, swivels and ducks. He then wants to review this for a wide for height, Axar thinks it's over his head. It isn't, by three centimetres according to the TV umpire. So it's a fair delivery
short of a length at the body from over the wicket to the left-hander, Axar opens the face on the back foot and steers to short third
short of a length outside off, Rahul cuts off the back foot through point
played back to the bowler, Markram slowed that up a far bit from around the wicket

caught at deep midwicket! Markram went around the wicket and angled the ball into the left-hander, Porel swung across the line and hit it straight to Miller, he was trying to clear the shorter square boundary but mis-timed it, he's gone for 51 after putting DC on course for their target
backs away outside leg again, Markram drags the length back and tries to cramp him for room, pulled to deep square leg
slapped off the back foot to deep point
backs away outside leg, Markram follows him with a flat and quick ball, Rahul pulls along the ground through square leg
steps out of his crease to a flighted delivery and tees off, golf-swinging the ball flat and far enough to just clear the straight boundary
goes back and dabs one that angles across him from over the wicket to short third, Porel wants the single but Rahul does not
hit hard off the back foot to deep cover, did not time it as well as he wanted
cut from off and middle stump, the fielder at point dives to his right and gets a hand on the ball to take pace off it
that's into the stands at deep midwicket, he got down on one knee and slammed the slog sweep flat and far over the short boundary
brings up his half-century by dabbing the ball into the covers for a quick single, first fifty of the season for him
a clean loft through the line and Porel collects six straight down the ground! He came forward to that full ball from around the wicket and swung hard through the line
bowled flat outside off from around the wicket, Porel cuts off the back foot through point
tight length on middle stump, Rahul goes back and nudges through midwicket
goes right back and flicks the ball off his pads to deep square
cut off the back foot to deep point
brings out the reverse-swat but gets a top edge that just clears short fine leg and runs to the boundary
steps out and lofts over the in field at cover, Bishnoi has to run to his left on the sweeper boundary to make the save
the line is outside off this time and Rahul cuts off the back foot but can't beat point
goes back and outside leg to nudge the ball with the angle into him from over the wicket to midwicket
one hand comes off the bat as he sweeps to long leg
bowled full on off and middle, Rahul moves forward and drives along the ground to long off
goes back and uses the angle into him from around the wicket to drag the pull to deep midwicket
nudged off the front foot on the leg side
tossed up outside off from around the wicket, driven on the front foot to wide long off, Pant is happy with this one, "This is your ball," he tells Bishnoi
driven down the ground for a single
Porel has nutmegged Pant by bottom edging a cut shot and hitting the ball hard between the keeper's pads, the fielder at fine leg saves the boundary
Porel reaches for one outside off on the front foot and opens the face to steer the ball wide of short third
worked off the front foot through midwicket for a single
around the wicket to the left-hander, swatted off the back foot to deep square leg

a huge appeal from Pant behind the stumps for lbw, the umpire is unmoved, will they review? Pant asks for the DRS. Was the impact outside the line? Rahul pushed forward at the ball with a big gap between bat and pad. The ball missed the inside edge of the bat and hit the front pad, but the impact is outside off stump and LSG lose a review.
goes around the wicket and angles the ball full and into the left-hander, Porel meets it on the front foot with a drive to long off
goes back and across, deep into his crease, to work the ball off the pads through midwicket
goes right back and whips a ball slanting across him against the angle between mid on and midwicket
goes back and punches to wide long off for another single
drifts wide outside off, Porel goes back and cuts to deep point, another misfield in the circle from Badoni this time
what happened there? Rahul was looking to pull a short of a length ball but that came on to him slowly off the pitch and he ended up toe-ending it towards mid on
shorter length and a straighter line, Porel punches off the back foot to long off

full toss outside off, slanting across the left-hander from over the wicket, Porel leans on the front foot and drives the ball through cover point, Bishnoi covers a lot of ground running to his right on the cover boundary and dives but can't stop it
nudged off the back foot between midwicket and mid on for a single
good length angling in to off stump, stays in his crease and punches to cover point
glanced off the pads and the fielder at short fine can't make the save diving to his right
another tight run for Rahul. Again the throw misses, this time at the non-striker's end. He dabbed the length ball off the back foot and ran right away
full ball outside off, dug out into the covers, that was nearly in the blockhole
length on the pads, Rahul stays in his crease and flicks behind square leg and into the gap on the boundary
Prince tests Rahul's response to the speedy bouncer, he lets it go calmly
ball doesn't come on to the bat as Rahul pushes off the front foot, mis-times it towards mid-on
Rahul has to hurry to the striker's end but the throw from backward point misses! He might have just been safe in the end. Porel jammed down at it off the back foot and they ran a really quick single
steps out and outside leg and whips a full ball through midwicket
bowled full and straight, Rahul drives down the ground to get going

what a reply from Markram, just hammered for six he comes right back and bowls him. Nair backed away outside leg to make room again, Markram followed him, Nair missed the slog across the line, and the ball hit his back thigh and went on to hit the stumps
backs away outside leg to create room and launches the ball straight over the bowler's head for a six down the ground, Nair got down on one knee and swung hard
strays wide down leg side, giving Pant some work to do
over the wicket to the right-hander, bowled flat and a bit quick, Nair tries to slow sweep and hits it to short fine leg
driven on the front foot through cover
moves back and slightly across to work a length delivery off his pads in front of square leg
tries to heave a length ball from outside off towards the leg side but misses
swings the ball to deep square leg for a couple of runs, Bishnoi fumbled it in the deep
it's a full toss this time and Porel plays a swat-drive past the bowler and between mid-off to find the boundary
charges down the pitch, Prince responds with a short ball, Porel aborts the shot and sways out of the way
length ball angling across the left-hander, Porel stays on the back foot and defends to cover
moves his front foot outside off stump, gets down on one knee and tries to slog sweep but misses, Rathi had slowed it up
slanting into the right-hander, Karun Nair plays it off the front foot to midwicket
driven on the front foot to long off
full and too wide, Porel leans into the cover drive and beats the diving Pooran to his left in the in-field, plenty of bottom hand in that shot
goes back in his crease to one that slants across him from over the wicket and skids off the pitch, defends on the off side
misfield at point from Shardul allows the single, Karun had cut it from his crease
straighter line and Porel pulls from just outside off to midwicket
Porel backs away outside leg to slash through the off side and gets an outside edge between the keeper and short third

Shardul appeals confidently for lbw as the ball nips in from a good length and hits Karun on the back leg as he stays in his crease and tries to play on the leg side, the ball trickles behind point for leg byes, that was too high
full ball down leg side
and again! This time through extra cover, the length was fuller from Shardul and Karun drove it with such grace all along the ground, Test-matchesque boundaries in a T20 world
sublime drive from Karun Nair, just a smooth punch off the front foot, letting the ball swing on to the middle of his bat and dispatching it between the bowler and mid off
nearly a first ball wicket for Shardul! Porel tries to pull a short ball that gets big on him and mis-times it towards mid-on, Miller rushes in from the edge of the circle but can't reach it
